scope.role: Bounded Codex worker, not Control Tower
scope.exact_ref_policy: Start clean HEAD == origin/master == GitHub master. Remote checked through GitHub connector after Git HTTPS failed. Freeze/stop on later origin movement; no merge/rebase.
scope.family_scope: B11-B19 plus ZL-EA-067 independent derivation; historical results remain historical and do not validate newly ratified xx-00 controls.

method.source_precedence: Current exact-ref state and subject owner -> exact accepted result -> source-bound artifact -> historical narrative/Second Brain. This atlas does not edit or overrule authoritative owners; conflicting statements are exposed.
method.comparison: Parent/child deltas stay inside each experiment's recorded MT5 install. Across rows only qualitative patterns are contrasted; no pooled ranking, cross-install acceptance-critical delta or average effect.
method.units: Matrix rows are mechanism/context summaries, not independent experiments. Multiple rows reuse the same report. Source count is unique documents, not cells/trades; distinct result-owner count is documentation coverage, not sample size.
method.evidence_assessment: SUPPORTED / WEAKLY_SUPPORTED / CONFLICTED / INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE are evidence-strength labels only, never new EA verdicts or Grade mappings.
method.unknowns: UNKNOWN / NOT_RUN / source-only / configuration-confounded / hard-cage ineligible stay explicit. Native EqDD differs from closed-deal proxy DD; displayed PF0 with no gross loss is UNDEFINED_NO_GROSS_LOSS.
method.windows: Cited modern M1 studies generally MAIN2023-2025 and BWD2020-2022; exact source owns interval/config. Historical B19 validation uses its own source identity; no fresh window or HOLDOUT selection.
method.evidence_reproduction: Owner-level synthesis and source-byte/ref validation only. No new tester run, raw performance re-analysis, artifact-package acceptance or independent review claimed.
method.generation: JSON is file-backed input; temporary Python builder renders Markdown and validates pinned source refs/required fields without long inline shell command.
